prompt: Compare my Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI setups and report where they differ. Do not change anything.
setup: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, and ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md each contain an agent-parity managed block with identical text, surrounded by different agent-specific text.

~/.claude.json defines user-scope servers 'github' (remote http) and 'analytics' (stdio with an env key); ~/.codex/config.toml defines only [mcp_servers.github]; ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json defines 'github' and 'analytics' without the env key.
~/.claude/skills and ~/.copilot/skills each contain 'commit-style/SKILL.md' with identical content; ~/.codex/skills does not exist.
All three agents have the 'tashtit' marketplace registered and 'maturity@tashtit' installed at the same version.
expected: The report names the three detected agents and their config homes.
Instructions are reported as in sync for all three files with the baseline rule stated.
MCP servers show 'analytics' as missing on Codex CLI and differing on Copilot CLI with the env key named, and 'github' as present everywhere.
Skills show 'commit-style' as missing on Codex CLI.
Plugins show 'maturity@tashtit' as installed on all three agents.
A parity percentage is shown with pair and gap counts per dimension and the fixed weights 3, 3, 2, 2.
Fixable gaps are offered with the file and operation each would touch, not applied.
must_not: Modify any file under a config home or in the repository.
Print the env value of the 'analytics' server or any text outside the managed instruction blocks.
Run any agent CLI, install, or network command.
Report a numeric score for a dimension with no pairs.
